reason: I already have an agency in Tashkent that does all of this for free and I can sit in their office and talk to a person. Why would I pay $99 by card in dollars to a website I have never heard of?
objection: Paying online in dollars by card is hard for me and risky; if something goes wrong, who do I go to? The refund promise means nothing if I can't find the company.
would_change_my_mind: If I could pay by Click or Payme in sums and someone I know, or my child's school, said they used it and it caught a mistake the agency made.
